mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as lower risk-free rates increase present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated FEDFUNDS above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, causing negative SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 500000 indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns through accelerated earnings growth in related sectors.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Low UNRATE < 3.5% with rising PAYEMS > 150000 indicates labor market tightness, supporting wage growth and consumer spending that drives positive SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings growth and positive SPX returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST > 1250 units signals robust housing construction, boosting related sectors and consumer confidence, generating positive SPX returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 1250.

mechanism_narrative: Joint FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0% creates optimal conditions for equity valuation through cheap capital and labor stability, driving positive SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth rate > 0.5% QoQ indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% QoQ.
